status: Owner-authorized new engineering iteration; not fabrication or live-cell approval

owner_inputs.printed_fit_feedback: These pieces all seem to fit and work well.
owner_inputs.outer_architecture: Single-piece printed cosmetic bell shell with removable flush/recessed front cartridge/grille and separate handle
owner_inputs.style: Original elegant flared handbell silhouette, gently concave sides and rounded crown; black printed handle first, wooden handle option later; no broad handguard disk
owner_inputs.reference_images: Two user-supplied images are visual inspiration only. No tracing, redistribution, logos or copied artwork are authorized.
owner_inputs.print_finish: Owner willing to print slowly with short layers for exterior finish; temperature/speed are to be grounded in the actual material and printer, not assumed qualified
owner_inputs.usb: Utilitarian access is acceptable. Prefer a thin wall near the receptacle and a modest opening for the plug metal nose; demonstrate both plug access and cartridge removal.
owner_inputs.handle_attachment: One central recessed screw from inside the bell, with a broad bearing area; printed handle first and predrilled wooden option later
owner_inputs.battery: Prefer an open/lightweight capture with visible PCB polarity markings; do not lower the cell without reconciling the actual contact geometry
owner_inputs.electrical_assembly: Investigate every fitted electronic component on F, with only the battery contacts on B; distinguish this from a genuinely single-operation assembly process
owner_inputs.routing_authorization: Begin layout when existing PCB through-hole mounts and the coordinated mechanical interfaces give reasonable confidence; no fabrication order authorized
owner_inputs.size: Do not enlarge unnecessarily. Preserve the successful internals wherever practical.

coordinate_frame.origin: Grille exterior/front mouth plane at z0
coordinate_frame.cell_z_basis: PCB B + selected contact's nominal 9.78 mm dimple height; loaded spring/cell geometry remains unqualified

initial_interface_targets.pcb_growth_policy: Compare 43 mm first; 46 mm and then 48 mm may be justified if coherent all-front electrical placement cannot fit. Report actual results, not an assumed packing win.
initial_interface_targets.usb_policy: Do not move the interface after coordinated release without a new mechanical bind. A closed port may not trap the cartridge.
initial_interface_targets.height_basis: Previous 45.55 mm bell body plus 10.75 mm exterior grille projection; not a target to increase
initial_interface_targets.contact_change_policy: Preserve the actual lands and spring/ear datums unless a documented alternative is qualified. B-side SMT contacts remain real assembly operations.
initial_interface_targets.handle_working_selection: M4 machine screw, broad washer and captive metal nut in keyed printed handle; near the size class of 8-32, not interchangeable threads. Final dimensions and engagement require the new mechanical model.

gates: Preserve all previous native models, scripts and print snapshots.
Match actual PCB, schematic, source libraries and placement/contact manifest bytes.
Keep component heights, F/B transforms and raw CELL_NEG versus protected GND explicit.
Positive contact metal beneath the cell still needs insulation and abrasion control even inside a plastic bell.
Handle and USB insertion loads must not be carried by the cell, IMU or unsupported solder joints.
Retain cell containment while the complete cartridge is outside the shell.
Do not treat silk PLA appearance as evidence of impact, creep, temperature or electrical suitability.
Native rule passes and inert print feedback are not functional, acoustic, live-cell or child-use qualification.
No purchased parts, live-cell experiments, manufacturing submissions or fabrication orders are authorized.
